03_base_case.specification.json.description: The funded Specification of walkthrough lesson 03 (cell 19), on 03_base_plan.model.json, with that Model. Walkthrough lesson 04 loads it. examples/data/derive_lesson_documents.py derives it from the cells of lesson 03 and base_plan.json.

03_base_plan.model.json.description: The Model of walkthrough lesson 03, with the commitments of its optional cell 21. Walkthrough lesson 04 loads it. examples/data/derive_lesson_documents.py derives it from the cells of lesson 03.

04_base_case.specification.json.description: The base Specification of walkthrough lesson 04 (cell 4), on 04_base_plan_on_paths.model.json, with that Model. Walkthrough lesson 05 loads it. examples/data/derive_lesson_documents.py derives it from the cells of lesson 04.

04_base_plan_on_paths.model.json.description: The Model of walkthrough lesson 04, with the rent index (cells 2 to 3b). Walkthrough lesson 05 loads it. examples/data/derive_lesson_documents.py derives it from the cells of lesson 04.

04_rent_index.paths.json.description: The 500 market paths of walkthrough lesson 04 (cells 5 to 8), with seed 1. Walkthrough lesson 05 loads them. examples/data/derive_lesson_documents.py derives them from the cells of lesson 04.

05_histories.paths.json.description: The three readable histories of walkthrough lesson 05, as market paths. examples/data/derive_lesson_documents.py gives their values.

associations.json.description: Model-scoped links from domain records to the original content IDs in transport.json.gz.

assumptions.json.description: Teaching assumptions for the property: the legacy rates, with the rents 10 % higher and the floor and facade OPEX rates 10 % lower (2026-10-31). origins.json gives the origin of each value.

audit.json.description: Counts, graph reconciliation, quantity checks and geometry summary checks of the conversion.

base_plan.json.description: The base plan of the development for walkthrough lesson 03, at 2027 prices: dates, budgets, incomes, operating costs, renewals, funding, areas and rates, each amount with its origin. examples/data/derive_base_plan.py derives it from inventory.csv, assumptions.json and development.json.

development.json.description: Teaching inputs for the development plan. origins.json gives the origin of each value.

inventory.csv.description: A readable inventory derived from model.json.

mapping.json.description: The author's interpretation of the source: classifications, units, properties and relationship labels.

model.json.description: The canonical Rangekeeper Model converted from transport.json.gz with mapping.json. It keeps the source content IDs.

origins.json.description: The origin of each teaching assumption in assumptions.json and development.json.

relationships.csv.description: Relationship endpoints, labels and identities derived from model.json.

totals_2032.json.description: Totals of the property in the stabilised year 2032 for walkthrough lesson 02: lettable area, rent and vacancy by use, operating cost and works cost, each with its origin. examples/data/derive_totals.py derives it from inventory.csv, assumptions.json and development.json.

transport.json.gz.description: The complete original transport records of Speckle project c0f66c35e3, model 119ad04487, object e7acaac21ae7e9369339900a4aaeb827, with the property and its context geometry. Received with specklepy 3.0.7; JSON is gzip-compressed.

geometry_storage: Complete original transport JSON, including context and property, in transport.json.gz

origin_vocabulary.derived: Made from other files in this folder: from the source capture by the conversion, or by a script that its description names. Recreate it; do not edit it by hand.
